rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex1.e1: Attack: with Black. A pawn one step from promoting threatens to become a queen, and the defence must spend pieces to stop it. In this lesson, you use that threat as a blow.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex1.e2: This position comes from a game played on Lichess. Your pawn on d2 is one step from promoting, but the rook on d1 blocks the square in front. The pawn can only promote by capturing on c1 or e1.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex1.p: Find the move that brings a white piece to the square where your pawn captures and promotes.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex1.certo: The queen gives check on e1. The king has no square, and only the rook on d1 can capture it: on e1 the rook is within reach of the pawn on d2.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex1.revela: The move is the queen to e1, with check: only the rook on d1 can capture it, and on e1 it is within reach of your pawn on d2.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex1.err.d8d7.1: The rook captures the knight on d7, but without check: White gains the time it needs against the pawn on d2.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex1.err.d8d7.2: With this move, White has a resource: the bishop on c1 captures the pawn on d2, and the threat to promote is over.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex1.err.d8d7.3: Back to the position: look for the check that brings a white piece to the square where your pawn captures and promotes.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex1.err.b8d7.1: The knight captures the knight on d7, but without check: White gains the time it needs against the pawn on d2.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex1.err.b8d7.2: With this move, White has a resource: the bishop on c1 captures the pawn on d2, and the threat to promote is over.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex1.err.b8d7.3: Back to the position: look for the check that brings a white piece to the square where your pawn captures and promotes.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex1.err.d2c1q.1: The pawn captures the bishop and promotes, but without check, and the new queen is within reach of both white rooks.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex1.err.d2c1q.2: With this move, White has a resource: the rook on a1 captures the new queen, and White is left with extra material.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex1.err.d2c1q.3: Back to the position: look for the check that brings a white piece to the square where your pawn captures and promotes.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex1.fora: That move does not help the pawn on d2 promote. Look for the check that brings a white piece to e1.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex1.volta: Try again: look for the check that brings a white piece to the square where your pawn captures.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex1.l1: If the rook does not capture, the white king is left in check with no way out. So it captures the queen.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex1.l2: The rook now stands on e1, the square the pawn on d2 reaches, and d1 is free.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex1.l3: The pawn captures the rook and promotes with mate: the new queen checks along the first rank, and the white king has no square.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex1.l4: Attraction and deflection serve the pawn: lure or remove the piece that guards the promotion square. In positions like this, a pawn close to promoting is worth more than the queen given up.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex2.e1: Attack: now with White, in another Lichess game. Your pawn on g7 promotes next move, but the black queen on h6 is close to your king.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex2.p: Find the promotion that wins the black queen.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex2.certo: The pawn promotes to a knight, with check, and the knight on g8 also attacks the queen on h6. Promoting to a piece other than a queen is called underpromotion.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex2.revela: The move is promoting to a knight, with check: the knight on g8 attacks the king and the queen on h6 at the same time. Promoting to a piece other than a queen is called underpromotion.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex2.err.g7g8q.1: The pawn promotes to a queen, but the new queen gives no check and does not attack the black queen.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex2.err.g7g8q.2: With this move, Black has a resource: the queen gives check on e3 and keeps checking your king, which cannot escape them.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex2.err.g7g8q.3: Back to the position: before promoting, see which new piece gives check and attacks the queen on h6.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex2.fora: That promotion does not win the black queen. See which new piece gives check and attacks h6.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex2.volta: Try again: compare the pieces the pawn can promote to.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex2.l1: The black king must get out of check, and none of its squares defends the queen on h6.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex2.l2: The king goes to f7, and the queen is still undefended.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex2.l3: The knight captures the queen with check. White is left with a knight and a pawn against a pawn.
rot.advancedPawn.ideia.ex2.l4: In positions like this, before promoting, compare the pieces: the queen is not always the best choice.
rot.advancedPawn.demos.partida.1: Attack: with White, in a game played on Lichess. Your pawn on g6 is two steps from promoting, and your bishop on e6 watches g8.
rot.advancedPawn.demos.partida.2: The pawn advances to g7 and threatens to promote on g8. To stop it, Black would have to give up the knight.
rot.advancedPawn.demos.partida.3: Black captures the bishop, but nothing of theirs reaches g8: the pawn promotes next move.
rot.advancedPawn.demos.partida.4: The pawn promotes with check. The threat to promote cost Black the game: the new queen against the knight decides.
rot.advancedPawn.demos.cavalo.1: Attack: White again. Your pawn on g7 can capture the rook on f8 and promote. First, see where the black queen is.
rot.advancedPawn.demos.cavalo.2: The pawn captures the rook and promotes to a knight, with check: the knight on f8 attacks the king and the queen on e6. As a queen, you would only win back the rook.
rot.advancedPawn.demos.cavalo.3: The king steps out of check, and the queen on e6 is left undefended.
rot.advancedPawn.demos.cavalo.4: The knight captures the queen with check. The underpromotion won the black queen: White has knight and bishop against bishop.
rot.advancedPawn.demos.excecao.1: Attack: now with Black. The queens attack each other on d2 and f2. Your queen on d2 watches e3, the square in front of your pawn on e4. Before trading queens, see who ends up in front of your pawn.
rot.advancedPawn.demos.excecao.p: Find the move that makes your pawn on e4 count.
rot.advancedPawn.demos.excecao.certo: The pawn advances to e3 and attacks the queen on f2. Your queen on d2 defends the pawn.
rot.advancedPawn.demos.excecao.revela: The move is the pawn to e3: it attacks the queen on f2, and your queen on d2 defends it.
The queen captures the queen on f2 with check, and the queens come off the board.
With this move, White has a resource: the king recaptures on f2 and stays close to your pawn on e4. Without the queen, the pawn cannot advance, and the white king reaches it.
Back to the position: look for the move that makes your pawn on e4 count.
The queen goes to d3 and defends the pawn on e4, but it leaves the white queen free to attack your king.
With this move, White has a resource: the queen gives check on f6 and starts attacking your king.
Back to the position: look for the move that makes your pawn on e4 count.
The queen goes to b4, but it leaves the white queen free to attack your king.
With this move, White has a resource: the queen gives check on f6 and starts attacking your king.
Back to the position: look for the move that makes your pawn on e4 count.
rot.advancedPawn.demos.excecao.2: If White does not capture your queen, Black mates in a few moves. So the white queen captures on d2.
rot.advancedPawn.demos.excecao.2a: The white queen captures on d2, and your pawn on e3 can recapture.
rot.advancedPawn.demos.excecao.2b: The pawn recaptures on d2, and nothing White has reaches d1: the pawn promotes next move.
rot.advancedPawn.demos.excecao.4: In positions like this, before trading the piece that supports the pawn, check whether the enemy king can stop it.
rot.advancedPawn.demos.excecao.s1: Compare with the queen trade on f2.
rot.advancedPawn.demos.excecao.s2: The queen captures on f2 with check, and the white king recaptures.
rot.advancedPawn.demos.excecao.s3: On f2 the white king watches e3, the square in front of your pawn on e4, and stops it, and the three white centre pawns decide.
rot.advancedPawn.pratica.valeAqui.enunci: Now you play. Before giving check, see whether the pawn already does the job. Play as Black and find the best move.
rot.advancedPawn.pratica.valeAqui.fim: The pawn advanced to h2 and threatens to promote on h1. The white rook must go back to guard h1, and your rook gains the time to attack.
rot.advancedPawn.pratica.valeAqui.err.g7: The rook gives check on g3, but nothing defends it: the white king captures it. Look for the pawn advance.
The rook goes to g1 before the pawn moves, and White gains time to bring the rook against it. Advance the pawn first.
rot.advancedPawn.pratica.coroa.err2.g1g8: The rook captures the bishop on g8 with check, but the black king captures the pawn on h7 and escapes. Capture on g8 with the pawn.
rot.advancedPawn.pratica.coroa.enunciado: White again. Your pawn on h7 is one step from promoting, but the black king stands on h8. Play as White and find the best move.
rot.advancedPawn.pratica.coroa.fim: The queen gave check on g8, and the bishop had to capture it. With a piece on g8, the pawn captured and promoted with mate.
rot.advancedPawn.pratica.coroa.err.b1c3: The knight leaves b1, but Black checks with the bishop on h6 and attacks your king. Look for the check that brings a black piece to g8.
rot.advancedPawn.pratica.coroa.err.b1a3: The knight leaves b1, but Black checks with the bishop on h6 and attacks your king. Look for the check that brings a black piece to g8.
rot.advancedPawn.pratica.cavalo.enunciad: Now with Black. Your pawn on f2 is one step from promoting, and your king is exposed to the white pieces. Play as Black and find the best move.
rot.advancedPawn.pratica.cavalo.fim: The pawn promoted to a knight, with check, and the knight on f1 also attacked the queen on g3. The king captured the pawn on h3, and the knight captured the queen.
rot.advancedPawn.pratica.cavalo.err.f2f1: Promoting to a queen gives no check, and the queen on g3 mates on h4. Look for the piece that promotes with check.
